detail.longDescription: 🤖 Rackspace is winding down Rackspace Spot after a Nov 17 breach. Stolen credentials let attackers create pods in customer clusters and read Kubernetes Secrets. Migrate by Dec 8, rotate tokens/kubeconfigs/Secrets. IoCs: 23.224.79.106, pod prefixes i1-/glm-/probe. 🔗 https://www. bleepingcomputer.com/news/secu rity/rackspace-shuts-down-spot-cloud-platform-after-security-breach/ # DataBreach # Kubernetes # CyberSec
